books.author: John J. Murphy
books.title: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets

rules.condition: Horizontal resistance with rising swing lows
rules.rule_quote: Ascending triangle indicates aggressive buyers stepping in at higher lows. Breakout with volume confirms continuation.
rules.fail_condition: Failure to break resistance followed by break below ascending trendline constitutes a distribution trap.

rules.condition: Left shoulder, lower head, higher right shoulder with neckline break
rules.rule_quote: A decisive break of the neckline with expanding volume completes the reversal pattern. Minimum target equals head-to-neckline depth.
rules.fail_condition: Retest failing and closing back below neckline invalidates pattern into a bull trap.

rules.condition: Prior resistance broken and tested from above
rules.rule_quote: Once a resistance level is decisively penetrated, it becomes a support level upon subsequent pullbacks.
rules.fail_condition: Deep penetration of broken resistance turning back into resistance signals a false breakout.

rules.condition: Price above 20 EMA, 50 EMA, and 200 EMA
rules.rule_quote: When price trades above ascending 20, 50, and 200 EMAs, the path of least resistance is up. Dips to 20/50 EMA are high-probability buying zones.
rules.fail_condition: Cross below 200 EMA with expanding volume signals a major trend regime change.

books.author: Al Brooks
books.title: Reading Price Charts Bar by Bar

rules.condition: Two-legged pullback with small overlapping bars into moving average in strong trend
rules.rule_quote: A weak, choppy two-legged pullback (High 2 setup) into the 20 EMA is the hallmark of institutional absorption. Expect trend resumption.
rules.fail_condition: Large consecutive trend bars against the primary trend invalidate the pullback and signal deep correction or reversal.

rules.condition: Consecutive large trend bars with massive expansion away from 20 EMA
rules.rule_quote: Late large trend bars far from the moving average represent buying/selling climax. Institutions use this to unload; never chase.
rules.fail_condition: Buying a climax bar yields terrible risk-to-reward; wait for a two-legged retracement.

rules.condition: Inside bar formed at key structural boundary or moving average
rules.rule_quote: Inside bars represent temporary balance. Breakout of inside bar high/low provides high-leverage tight stop entries.
rules.fail_condition: Immediate reversal back through the opposite side of the mother bar produces a whipsaw.

rules.condition: Green body completely covers preceding red candle body at support
rules.rule_quote: Bullish engulfing at a support or oversold zone shows bulls completely overwhelming bears in a single session.
rules.fail_condition: If subsequent candle closes below the low of the engulfing candle, the setup is dead.

rules.condition: Red body completely covers preceding green candle body at resistance
rules.rule_quote: Bearish engulfing at resistance marks strong rejection and seller dominance.
rules.fail_condition: Close above engulfing candle high invalidates.

rules.condition: Bearish candle, followed by small indecision star, followed by strong bullish candle closing >50% of first candle
rules.rule_quote: Morning Star is a premier three-candle bottom reversal pattern indicating decisive exhaustion of selling pressure.
rules.fail_condition: Close below the star's low confirms failed reversal.

rules.condition: Long lower shadow (2-3x body) rejecting key support level
rules.rule_quote: The long lower shadow reflects rejection of lower prices by institutions stepping in with aggressive limit bids.
rules.fail_condition: Immediate break of the hammer's low indicates trapped buyers.

rules.condition: Long upper shadow rejecting resistance with small lower body
rules.rule_quote: Shooting star shows intraday rally completely faded by aggressive institutional supply.
rules.fail_condition: Breakout above the upper wick invalidates.

rules.condition: Last bearish down-close candle prior to an aggressive upward displacement that breaks market structure (BOS)
rules.rule_quote: The Bullish Order Block (OB) is where institutions placed large buy orders. Retests into the top/midpoint (consequent encroachment) of this block offer sniper long entries.
rules.fail_condition: A candle body close below the bottom of the Order Block invalidates the institutional structure.

rules.condition: Last bullish up-close candle prior to an aggressive downward displacement breaking structure
rules.rule_quote: Institutions mitigated longs and loaded shorts in this block. Retest of the Bearish OB offers high-probability shorting.
rules.fail_condition: A candle body close above the Bearish OB high invalidates.

rules.condition: 3-candle imbalance where Candle 1 High and Candle 3 Low do not overlap (Bullish FVG)
rules.rule_quote: FVGs represent inefficient price delivery caused by institutional urgency. Price gravitationally returns to balance these gaps before continuing.
rules.fail_condition: Full displacement through the FVG without reaction indicates opposite-side order flow dominance.

rules.condition: Price pierces previous swing high/low (BSL/SSL), triggers stop orders, and sharply reverses inside the range
rules.rule_quote: Market makers hunt retail breakout traders and stop-losses to engineer liquidity for their opposing large orders. Trade in the direction of the sweep reversal.
rules.fail_condition: Continued displacement beyond the liquidity level with strong volume confirms real breakout rather than a sweep.

rules.condition: Price retraces into the lower 50% (Discount) of the dealing range, ideally 61.8% to 78.6% OTE
rules.rule_quote: Smart money never buys in Premium (>50%). They buy in Discount (<50%) at unmitigated demand or order blocks.
rules.fail_condition: Break below the dealing range swing low invalidates the higher-timeframe bullish structure.

books.author: Richard D. Wyckoff
books.title: The Wyckoff Method of Trading and Investing

rules.condition: Terminal shakeout below trading range support that quickly re-enters range on declining or absorbing volume
rules.rule_quote: The Wyckoff Spring is the ultimate test of supply in Phase C. It clears all weak-hand stops before the markup begins.
rules.fail_condition: If price continues falling with expanding volume (markdown), the Spring is aborted.

rules.condition: Wide spread candle on expanding volume breaking above resistance of trading range (Jump Across the Creek)
rules.rule_quote: SOS proves smart money has absorbed floating supply. Wait for a low-volume Backup (LPS) to buy.
rules.fail_condition: Failure to hold above broken resistance turns SOS into an Upthrust.

rules.condition: Temporary false breakout above trading range resistance followed by rapid breakdown back into the range
rules.rule_quote: UTAD traps breakout buyers and triggers buy-stops before smart money initiates markdown.
rules.fail_condition: Sustained trading above range with heavy volume invalidates distribution.

books.author: Anna Coulling
books.title: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

rules.condition: High volume with narrow spread candle at support or large volume with bullish candle closing near highs
rules.rule_quote: High volume at support with narrow spread indicates smart money absorbing selling. Price will soon rally.
rules.fail_condition: High volume with large downward spread indicates real supply hitting the market.

rules.condition: Price breaks support or resistance but volume is below 20-period moving average
rules.rule_quote: Breakouts on low volume lack institutional commitment. Low volume breakout is a high-probability bull/bear trap.
rules.fail_condition: Follow-through volume stepping in later can salvage, but initial trade must be avoided.

rules.condition: Deep downtrend met with ultra-high volume and long lower wick
rules.rule_quote: Stopping volume signals institutional buyers absorbing the final wave of panicking retail sellers.
rules.fail_condition: Continued heavy volume pushing lower breaks stopping level.
